product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides infrastructure and managed AI-agent teams that automate running businesses end-to-end, for developers and people building or operating autonomous companies.

named_customers.notes: Public sources describe customers and use cases but do not name at least two customers.

eng_blog.notes: The index has one Engineering post and otherwise lists Launch posts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Founding Member of Technical Staff — RL and Founding Member of Technical Staff - Agents.

model_provider.notes: The public materials describe a model catalogue/router and compatible interfaces, but do not identify a provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy and legal pages describe security measures but name none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open board lists video, growth, technical-staff and product-engineering roles, but no SDR, BDR, sales representative or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: The site records a latest release on November 6, 2026; the blog also lists launches on November 2 and October 17, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public team profile identifies the founders but shows no C-level or VP join/leave event dated within the window.
